thread:
zoe: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A on API/Console/Optimize timelines — dropping a concise thread to capture decisions.

diego: thanks. can we confirm the GA window for the Console routing UI and the Optimize recommender? customers are planning pilots.

zoe: routing UI beta: mid-Q3; GA: late-Q3. Optimize recommender canary: mid-Q3 (10% traffic). Optimize GA: late-Q3 for hosted, Dedicated rollouts Q3->Q4.

maya: clarify: will the Console beta include the one-click apply for suggestions or just visual guidance?

oliver: Console beta will show suggestions and a preview mode only. one-click apply moves to canary after monitoring. owners: lina (Console), michael (Optimize).

diego: compatibility note for docs? model / quantization caveats?

maya: initial compatibility: decoder-only transformers (FP16, INT8). 4-bit quant is experimental and marked in UI. suggestions will not auto-apply to customer configs unless explicitly accepted.

ops-bot: canary checklist: enable perf probes, prompt-set evals, rollback hooks. playbook: https://internal.redwood/canary/guide

zoe: rollback thresholds from eng?

oliver: rollback if p95 latency > 20% sustained for 10m, or quality regressions on evals for 2 runs. cost upticks >40% alone won't auto-rollback.

diego: action items:
- lina: UX mock + beta note by Tue EOD
- michael: canary gating doc + metrics by Thu
- diego: customer timeline blurb + example API by Fri

maya: example API snippet for docs: `POST /v1/projects/{proj}/routes/{route}/suggestions/apply` body: `{"suggestion_id":"sugg-2822","apply_mode":"preview"}`

zoe: thanks all — i'll update the public roadmap sheet after the deliverables land. ping here when items are posted. :thumbsup:
